entries.target: A short range status skill that applies to yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Your next auto attack will be a critical strike. Has a chance to apply Prophetic Vision increasing intellect and critical strike damage by 30% for 15 seconds.
entries.evidence: Foresight Rank Needed: 1 Mana Cost: 5 Mana Cooldown: 8 Seconds Type: Magical Range: A short range status skill that applies to yourself. Description: Your next auto attack will be a critical strike. Has a chance to apply Prophetic Vision increasing intellect and critical strike damage by 30% for 15 seconds. Note: Foresight aura lasts 5 seconds and actually turns all auto attacks into guaranteed crits.

entries.target: An infinite range skill that heals 7 friendly targets.
entries.officialDescription: Heals yourself and up to 6 others, while placing a random judgment on each based on their relationship with the Divine. The heal is twice as strong if another player is selected. If an enemy is selected, you will be healed for twice the amount.
notes: Close Friends: Increases Strength & Intellect by 20% for 20 seconds.
Befriended: Strong heal over time for 15 seconds.
Divine Acquaintances: Moderate heal over time for 15 seconds.
It's Complicated: Reduces damage taken and Luck by 10% for 10 seconds.
Unfriended: Increases mana costs by 10% and reduces Endurance by 10% for 10 seconds.
